items.title: 56800_John Simmons oral history interview
items.q: Then they had Joe Harris in the band for awhile.

ctx.x: And this was the time that "Things to Come" had just come out?

No. They had recorded that when they were at the Famous Door. See, that's when they was in the big band, at the Famous Door. And then they moved from the Famous Door down to the Roost. And boy, the Famous Door, they kept it hopping. They had Kenny Clark in the band for awhile. Then they had Joe Harris in the band for awhile. Joe Harris was a beautiful drummer, very underrated. Quite a few people aren't even aware that there is a Joe Harris. He came out here and stayed a little while, and now he's in Europe. He…
of it. He couldn't get a vibrato out of his first set. Sounded like he was tap dancing.
